title: Add GET /api/devices/{device_name}/arc-status endpoint for Azure Arc connection status
body:
Adds a new authenticated endpoint that queries Azure Resource Manager to return the connection state of the three Arc-connected resources (host, VM, K8s cluster) for a given IoT Operations site.

## Service Layer (`app/services/arc_status_reader.py`)
- `ArcStatusReader` class using `DefaultAzureCredential` + a shared `httpx.Client` for ARM REST calls
- Static `derive_resource_names(cluster_name)` strips datacenter prefix and `-k3s`/`-vm` suffixes to produce the three resource names:
  - `atl-azureiot-vm-k3s` → k8s=`atl-azureiot-vm-k3s`, vm=`azureiot-vm`, host=`azureiot`
- Static `build_resource_group(hub, country)` → `EXP-MFG-AIO-{HUB}-{COUNTRY}-RG`
- ARM 404 raises `LookupError` (→ HTTP 404); other ARM errors propagate (→ HTTP 502)

## Route (`app/api/routes/devices.py`)
- `GET /api/devices/{device_name}/arc-status` — requires `ClaimsDep` auth
- Fetches `hub` and `country` from Eventhouse via the existing `EventhouseStatusReader`, then delegates ARM calls to `ArcStatusReader`
- Returns 502 with a clear message when `hub`/`country` are absent (pending Phase 4 Kusto function update adding `country` column)

```json
{
  "deviceName": "atl-azureiot-vm-k3s",
  "resourceGroup": "EXP-MFG-AIO-ATL-US-RG",
  "host":       { "resourceName": "azureiot",         "resourceType": "Microsoft.HybridCompute/machines",    "status": "Connected" },
  "vm":         { "resourceName": "azureiot-vm",      "resourceType": "Microsoft.HybridCompute/machines",    "status": "Connected" },
  "k8sCluster": { "resourceName": "atl-azureiot-vm-k3s", "resourceType": "Microsoft.Kubernetes/connectedClusters", "status": "Connected" }
}
```

## Config & DI
- `AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID` added to `Settings` and `.env.example`
- `get_arc_status_reader()` registered as `@lru_cache` singleton in `dependencies.py`

## Tests (`tests/test_arc_status.py`)
- Parametrized unit tests for `derive_resource_names` and `build_resource_group`
- Endpoint tests via `FakeArcStatusReader` / `FakeStatusReaderForArc` stubs covering happy path, 404 (device not in Eventhouse, ARM resource not found), 502 (Eventhouse error, ARM failure, missing hub/country), and 400 (invalid device name)
- `test_security.py` `_make_settings()` updated to include `azure_subscription_id` after `Settings` dataclass change
